flags.message: Forward cell, not mis-provisioned: the Court called for a response on 2026-08-03 after the respondents waived, and the BIO was filed 2026-10-02, so the single distribution the context freezes (the 2026-09-28 conference) was superseded before consideration. The petition will be redistributed after the reply; the relist-increment claim is near-certain for structural reasons rather than as a forecast of Court interest. The provisioned petition text is truncated (139-page PDF, appendix cut), but the petition body itself was complete through its conclusion.
